# rolecall

> RoleCall — config management & orchestration CLI. Runs on Node >=22.19 and Bun >=1.4.2.

Documentation for rolecall. Every page below links to its Markdown source; the whole site as a single file is at https://rolecall.example.com/llms-full.txt
